87 cu ft of maximum cargo with a flat load floor and a deep well behind the third row
Driver Talk intercom and Quiet Mode are parent-focused features nobody else offers at this price
10 yr / 100,000 mi powertrain warranty on a family vehicle people intend to keep
Naturally aspirated V6 on regular fuel: simple, proven, and 5,500 lb of towing

use_cases: Road trips with luggage for six
Towing a small camper or boat up to 5,500 lb

ownership.5yr_cost_note: Fuel is the main cost line at 23 mpg. Strong resale offsets it; Tellurides have historically traded near or above book.
ownership.reliability_note: The 3.8L Lambda V6 is a long-running, well-understood engine. No turbo, no CVT, no hybrid system - fewer failure modes than most rivals.

sales_objections.response: It is the honest trade for a V6 that tows 5,500 lb and never needs premium fuel. At 12,000 miles a year the difference against a 28-mpg rival is about $450 annually - roughly one payment. Decide whether the third-row space is worth that.

Correct. If maximum mpg is the priority, the Grand Highlander Hybrid is the right vehicle and I will say so. What the Telluride gives back is a simpler powertrain, a roomier third row and a 10-year warranty.

Shared bones, different execution. The Telluride is boxier with a more upright third row and more headroom back there; the Palisade is the plusher, more formal one. Sit in the third row of each - that is where the decision gets made.

sales_objections.objection: Kia is not a premium brand.
sales_objections.response: Sit in an SX Prestige with Nappa leather and the dual 12.3 in displays, then price the equivalent Acura or Volvo. You are looking at a $12,000-$15,000 difference for the same content and a longer warranty.

talk_tracks: Put the customer in the third row during the walkaround - it is the single most persuasive moment.
Demonstrate Driver Talk and Quiet Mode with kids present; parents close on those features.
Frame the 10-year powertrain warranty against the fact that families keep three-row SUVs longer than any other body style.
